breaks.quote: One honest note. Her research does not claim to measure regret as a feeling inside a chimpanzee.
breaks.why: A protective caveat about what the study does not prove, added for safety rather than for the reader, which the rule says to cut.

breaks.quote: In Kibale National Park, Uganda, a primatologist named Rachna Reddy spent years watching one thing
breaks.why: The study opens Insight 1 and runs for many paragraphs with place and group detail, instead of his idea coming first and then 2 to 5 sentences of one finding.

breaks.quote: Then one day Melvin makes the mistake that costs him. He reaches for a female who belongs to a male above him
breaks.why: A made-up scene is told as part of the research, so the reader cannot tell what the study found from what was added, and the facts are not kept true.
